review_cost.rationale: All asks are small, localized, and mechanical — nits plus one robustness fix, not rework.

findings.issue: getIndex() caches a rejected buildIndex() promise for the process lifetime; a single transient API error during the first request makes every page return 500 until restart.
findings.suggestion: In the catch path, set indexPromise = null (as apiFetch already does for its cache at api.js:19) so the next request retries the build.

findings.issue: Genus and latest-English-flavor-text logic is re-implemented inline, duplicating api.js's englishGenus (dead code, api.js:42) and latestEnglishFlavor (api.js:46).
findings.suggestion: Import and reuse the api.js helpers and delete the dead export.

findings.issue: Three per-file serveStatic({ path }) registrations; the comment claims paths are 'resolved relative to the app directory' but the documented behavior is relative to process CWD, making startup location fragile.
findings.suggestion: Use a single serveStatic({ root: './public' }) under a route like /assets/*, or resolve paths with import.meta.url.

findings.issue: An htmx request for a Pokémon whose data fails to load returns the full 404 page, which gets swapped into the #moves-inner fragment target, producing a broken page-in-page.
findings.suggestion: Return a small 404-status fragment (or a friendly inline error) when c.req.header('HX-Request') is set.

findings.issue: PAGE_SIZE (pagination config) is defined in the view module but consumed by the router; other config like API_BASE lives in api.js.
findings.suggestion: Move PAGE_SIZE next to the data/query concerns in api.js or a small constants module.

findings.issue: index.typeEn.get.bind(index.typeEn) and the curried typeBadgeLink(typeEn) are awkward ways to thread the type-name map.
findings.suggestion: Pass a plain typeEn(name) function (already defined in pokemonPage/typePage) consistently instead of binding Map methods.

findings.issue: htmx.org is declared as a dependency but only a vendored copy in public/ is served, so npm updates never reach the app.
findings.suggestion: Serve htmx from node_modules via serveStatic, or drop the dependency and document the vendored copy.

summary: A clean, idiomatic Hono + htmx app that maps almost one-to-one onto the spec and is easy to navigate. The one must-fix before merge is the poisoned global index promise, which turns any transient API hiccup into a permanent 500 state; the rest are mechanical dedup and idiom nits. I'd approve after one light round of changes.
